title: [ingest] feat(mcp): ORCH_WORKSPACE env to target a workspace independent of cwd
summary: mcp-graph.js posted process.cwd() as the daemon workspace on startup, so any process loading the orchestrator MCP (e.g. a headless agent in a git worktree) hijacked the global workspace pointer — repointing the live graph and blinding the agent to the real workspace's learnings/context. Now honors ORCH_WORKSPACE when set (else cwd, unchanged). Dogfood-finding #1.
